messages.Los textos tienen historia. Sigue un hil: Texts have a history. Follow a thread and discover how they may have met.
messages.A tu ritmo · Sin conocimientos previos: At your pace · No prior knowledge needed
messages.Aprende a leer el mapa mientras exploras: Learn to read the map as you explore a story.
messages.Tu recorrido se guarda solo en este nave: Your progress is saved only in this browser. You can revisit any thread.
messages.Empieza por una pregunta. Los controles: Start with a question. The controls will follow.
messages.Cada círculo reúne sus etapas. Pulsa uno: Each circle brings its stages together. Select one to discover who may have composed them, and when.
messages.Pulsa su etiqueta: encontrarás la razón: Select its label to find the grounds for access, assumptions and sources. A quotation is only one possible route.
messages.Etapas muestra fechas estimadas. Afinar: Stages shows estimated dates. Refine the map lets you compare scenarios and reveal pending candidates, without arrowheads.
messages.Arrastra el fondo para recorrer el mapa;: Drag the background to move around the map; use + to zoom in. Esc returns you to the map.
messages.Del hebreo al griego, dentro de un mismo: From Hebrew to Greek, within the same book.
messages.Eclesiástico es un solo círculo, pero re: Sirach is one circle, but brings together a Hebrew collection and its Greek translation. Open the first stage to look inside the book.
messages.La etapa conserva una datación propuesta: The stage preserves a proposed dating and its grounds. See how it appears on a timeline: an interval is not an exact date.
messages.Las dos etapas pertenecen al mismo libro: Both stages belong to the same book. Their connection assesses whether the translator could have known a Hebrew antecedent before producing the Greek text.
messages.¿Qué nos permite decir la flecha?: What does the arrow let us say?
messages.La justificación está justo debajo. El t: The justification is just below. The translator’s testimony and textual evidence converge; the specific exemplar remains unidentified.
messages.El traductor pudo conocer el antecedente: The translator could have known the pertinent Hebrew antecedent.
messages.Conoció exactamente cada versículo del l: The translator knew precisely every verse of the present book.
messages.La evaluación se limita a una forma ante: The assessment concerns a pertinent antecedent form. It does not reconstruct a complete exemplar or every later expansion.
messages.Ya puedes pasar de un libro a sus etapas: You can now move from a book to its stages, read intervals and examine a route of access.
messages.¿Puede un autor conocer lo que escribió: Can an author know what they wrote before?
messages.Empieza con 1 Tesalonicenses. El mapa pu: Start with 1 Thessalonians. The map can show possible access even when the later text does not quote the earlier letter.
messages.La autoría paulina compartida y el orden: Shared Pauline authorship and the order of composition ground this inference. Read the reason and its assumptions below: plausible access and literary reuse are different claims.
messages.El vínculo no exige una cita. Su alcance: The connection does not require a quotation. Its scope depends on shared attribution and compatible chronological priority within the scenario.
messages.Una reutilización literaria demostrada d: Demonstrated literary reuse of the earlier letter.
messages.Acceso plausible por composición propia,: Plausible access through own composition, with explicit assumptions.
messages.Componer un texto da una vía de conocimi: Composing a text provides a route to knowing its content. That does not establish that the author reused it in another work.
messages.Ya puedes distinguir una vía de acceso d: You can now distinguish a route of access from literary dependence and recognize an inference with assumptions.
messages.Lo que aún no sabemos: What we do not yet know
messages.Una candidatura también cuenta una histo: A candidate connection also tells a story.
messages.Marcos ofrece un punto de partida para e: Mark offers a starting point for exploring proposed sources of other gospels. Open an assessment and examine its grounds.
messages.Esta admisión de trabajo declara sus sup: This working admission states its assumptions about Mark’s circulation. Compare it with another connection that remains pending: Matthew and Luke.
messages.La candidatura aparece sin punta de flec: The candidate appears without an arrowhead because access is not sufficiently resolved. Change scenarios to compare another hypothesis.
messages.Compara la justificación del otro escena: Compare the justification in the other scenario. The candidate retains its reservations: proposing a route does not by itself settle the assessment. The Farrer hypothesis is considered in the alternative scenario.
messages.Sí: la anterioridad y el parecido bastan: Yes: chronological priority and resemblance are enough.
messages.No: hace falta justificar el acceso con: No: access must be justified with convergent evidence.
messages.La regla exige una forma pertinente prev: The rule requires a pertinent prior form, a plausible route and access during the recipient’s activity. Dates and resemblance alone do not admit an arrow.
messages.Ya puedes reconocer una candidatura, com: You can now recognize a candidate, compare scenarios and preserve uncertainty when evidence is lacking.
messages.Tu hilo te espera. Continúa cuando quier: Your thread is waiting. Continue whenever you like.
The map feels a little more familiar now.
messages.Has abierto otro texto. Puedes explorarl: You opened another text. Explore it or return to the thread; your step is saved.
